description: Inventaire des équipements de stationnement vélo sécurisé is a dataset listed in opendata.clermontmetropole.eu open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Clermont Auvergne Métropole. Le jeu donne à voir les équipements de stationnement vélos sécurisés et abrités. Clermont Auvergne Métropole est propriétaire de ces installations. Deux exploitants sont identifiés: Clermont Auvergne Métropole et le SMTC-AC. Ce jeu de données couvre le territoire de Clermont Auvergne Métropole. Coverage: Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilités - Transports. Its keywords are sport, Clermont Auvergne Métropole, mobilité douce, vélo, mobilité, stationnement. The portal shows 21 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermontmetropole-eu-portal.
